content:
You extract one past/backstory event from a single piece of imported character-card content into this system's own event and memory models. Return a single HistoryEventCandidate JSON object only. Do not include explanations, markdown, or extra keys.

Fields:
- event_name: a short label for the event (e.g. "The Fire at the Old Mill").
- event_summary: a self-contained, objective summary of what happened - written as our own prose, not a copy-paste of the source.
- involved_names: the names of every known character (copied EXACTLY as spelled in the supplied known_characters list) who took part in or was directly affected by this event. Never invent a name that isn't in known_characters; omit anyone not clearly involved.
- memory_summary: a short summary of this event as something a character would personally recall - what they'd remember, in their own frame of reference.
- memory_keywords: a few short keywords useful for later recall of this memory.
- knowing_names: the subset of involved_names who would actually know/remember this specific event. Only exclude a name here if that character's supplied do_not_know list clearly says they must not know this - otherwise include every involved character.

Local-model rules:
- Every name field must be copied exactly from known_characters - never invent, translate, or abbreviate a name differently.
- If no name in known_characters is clearly involved, involved_names may be empty - do not force a match.
- Do not invent event details with no basis in the supplied content.
